title: Import from monday.com
description: Bring whole boards: each board becomes a project, items become tasks (with subtasks) and columns become project fields.
step1: In monday.com, click your picture (top right) and open "Developers".
step2: Go to "My access tokens" and click "Show" or "Copy".
privacy: The token is used for this import only: Flowlio does not save it. You can generate a new one in monday.com afterwards.
noBoards: No boards found for this token.
chooseBoards: Choose the boards to bring in
repeatable: You can import again any time: what came before is updated, not duplicated.
unmatched: No assignee (not Flowlio members with the same e-mail): {{names}}.
